method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: The gateway panorama stands about 4 m from the facade and was placed on the joint with the 1964 block and its base row (camera 2.3 m high); it fixes the gateway and the ground-floor cornice (3.56 m). The east panorama was placed on the east corner at that cornice height and chained on the joint and the gateway edge in a second view along the street; its window positions agree with the gateway view within about 0.2 m. The roof, the eaves height above the measured window heads and the courtyard wing are estimates.
